rationale:
The architecture follows the decisions recorded in Mission memory: creating a standalone `components/Footer.tsx` and integrating it into `app/layout.tsx`. 

I verified `app/layout.tsx` uses a flexbox layout (`flex flex-col min-h-full`), which is ideal for a "sticky" footer pattern where the footer stays at the bottom even on short pages. Since the `components/` directory was not found during file listing, the SWE will need to create it.

Styling will rely on Tailwind CSS utilities to satisfy the requirement for light/dark mode support without introducing new design tokens.
